$description: TubHop, the hot tub app (tubhop.app) and its marketing site. Deep End navy, Water teal and Heat orange from the TubHop logo, on a warm Foam page. Open Sans and Flint's spacing, radius and type stay as they are.

$source.kept: Type, spacing, radius, shadows, feedback colors and charts match Flint.

swapped.Water #14A3B8 (teal.500): 3.02:1 on white. Logo only. Text and links use teal.900 #09454E (10.64:1); dark mode uses teal.300.
swapped.Heat #FF6B3D (heat.400): 2.83:1 on white, 2.55:1 on Foam. Logo and decoration only (action.secondary). The light focus ring uses heat.600 #C22E00 (5.14:1 on Foam) so it clears 3:1.
swapped.Muted #4A5F6B (deep.500): 6.03:1 on Foam, under Flint's 7:1 text bar. Muted text uses deep.600 #2F4A5B.
swapped.Foam #F6F3EC (foam.100): Flint's chart amber is 2.87:1 on it, under 3:1. The page uses foam.50 #FBFAF6, a step lighter; foam.100 stays for brand art.
swapped.Dark surfaces: Deep End #0D2230 is the card surface and deep.950 the page, so Flint's chart blue clears 3:1 on cards.
swapped.Heat button with Deep End label: 5.76:1, under 7:1. The primary button is Deep End navy with a white label instead.

$source.added: Dark mode: Deep End surfaces, teal.300 primary with a Deep End label, heat.400 focus ring. Charts keep Flint's palette in both modes so the color-vision check holds.
